external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Itron provides advanced water metering and smart infrastructure solutions that help utilities accurately measure usage, detect leaks, automate meter reading, and improve operational efficiency through data-driven insights and connected AMI/AMR technologies.

Diehl’s advanced water metering and smart infrastructure solutions—including ultrasonic meters, AMR/AMI communication systems, and data management software—help utilities accurately measure usage, detect leaks, and improve the efficiency and sustainability of water networks.

Honeywell offers reliable water metering and communication solutions—including high-accuracy meters, AMR/AMI connectivity, and data management technologies—that help utilities automate meter reading, improve billing accuracy, and gain better visibility into water usage across their systems.

FCS (Fluid Conservation Systems) is known for innovative water network monitoring solutions and remote water monitoring systems designed to help our nation’s water authorities, municipalities, and utilities proactively detect underground leaks and protect critical water resources.

A.Y. McDonald is a family-owned American manufacturer specializing in water works, plumbing, and natural gas products. The company serves utilities and contractors nationwide while maintaining a strong focus on customer relationships, ethical practices, and reliable infrastructure solutions.

Kamstrup provides grid insights that optimize operations’ network capacity, and the production and distribution of water and energy. Their solutions also allow consumers and businesses alike to use resources smarter
In January 2026, Mountain States officially joined United Systems & Software as a wholly-owned subsidiary.
